summary.root_cause_text: Ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable. Payments failed silently, logged only at DEBUG, and orders were marked processed without payment. The order worker was stuck in a wait state with the queue backing up. Its heartbeat age was 12.1s before the restart.
recommended: Validate the payments-v2 endpoint before any future migration.
Alert on payment provider failures, which are currently logged only at DEBUG.
Find out why the worker went into a wait state after payment failures.

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
Fix the config first. Restarting the worker comes later, if it's needed.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.

Still broken:
- [business] payment_gap: 20 of 86 orders were processed but have no payment.
- [business] queue_backlog: Queue depth 49 and growing (was 40).

1 matching lines (of the last 5000). Most frequent messages:
  1x [DEBUG] worker: worker entered wait state
Most recent 1 lines:
{"ts": "2026-10-31T06:33:52.098+00:00", "level": "DEBUG", "component": "worker", "msg": "worker entered wait state"}
The worker is stuck in its wait state. Payments now work, so a restart is safe.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
